test_title: PYST 03: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: A neutron has no electrical charge.
The central part of an atom contains only protons.
The central part of an atom contains only neutrons.
The central part of an atom contains only electrons.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A neutron has no electrical charge.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A neutron has no electrical charge.** Neutrons are neutral subatomic particles found in the nucleus of an atom.
 
• The central part of an atom, called the nucleus, contains both **protons and neutrons**.
